div.head: A BRIEF EXPOSITION Of the firſt Epiſtle General of PETER.

epigraph.q: Verſ. 4. To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reſerved in Heaven for you.

div.p: The ſecond reaſon of that Song of praiſe which all the Regenerate ſhould keep up in their hearts, is, that they have a matchleſs inheritance to look for beyond

epigraph.q: Verſ. 5. Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto ſalvation, ready to be revealed in the laſt time.

div.p: The third reaſon of the joy and conſtancy of ſuffering Believers, is, That their perſeverance is made ſure, the Almighty Power of God being imployed as their
ſervice, to wit, an undoubted right to the ſalvation of his ſoul through Chriſt: for, the word, Receiving, here, whereby the Apoſtle expreſſeth the act of

epigraph.q: Verſ. 10. Of which ſalvation the Prophets have enquired, and ſearched diligently, who propheſied of the grace that ſhould come unto you.
